description: This line plot illustrates the memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for five different models—VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, LLLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA—as a function of the number of video frames processed, ranging from 0 to 1000 frames on a linear x-axis. The y-axis represents memory usage in GB, scaled linearly from 0 to 400 GB, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 50 GB. The VideoLLaMB model is represented by a red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 15 GB and rising to about 35 GB by 1000 frames. The VideoLLaMB-R model, shown as a gold line with circular markers, begins near 10 GB and increases slightly to about 35 GB. The LLaVA-NeXT model, depicted with a teal line and circular markers, starts at roughly 15 GB and steadily climbs to approximately 145 GB. The VideoLLAVA model, indicated by a purple line with circular markers, begins at around 15 GB and exhibits a steep, exponential increase, reaching over 400 GB by approximately 300 frames before the x-axis ends. The VideoLLaMB-R model shows minimal growth compared to the others, remaining below 40 GB throughout the frame range.
